name: The Class XI stall at the science fair
subject: projects
brief: Class XI is running a stall at the school science fair: a poster, a working model of a lock and a short spoken script. Three of you share the work and the period is short. You are the chair. Two of the jobs suit more than one of you; one of you has something on that nobody has mentioned.

tasks.name: Build the working model of the lock
Write and rehearse the spoken script

facts.text: Tara runs in the district meet next week and can carry only one job
Ishan takes the 5:40 bus and has to leave on the bell

note: Tara Das and Ishan Sheikh are from INDIA_WORLD_BIBLE.md (npc_tara_das, npc_ishan_sheikh). The constraint is capacity: Tara's training week limits what she can carry, which only a conversation with her shows. Any assignment within each member's capacity that gives every job to someone it suits is Sound.
